{{Quote|Lest my statements convey an impression that the hardest decisions are behind us, let me hasten to add that much work remains to be done. So much rebuilding; so much reordering&hellip;To you, all of you, will I look for guidance in determining which worlds we should welcome back into the Republic's embrace, and which, if any, should be kept at arm's length, or shunned for the injuries they have heaped upon us. Similarly will I look to you for guidance in reshaping our Constitution to conform to the needs of the new epoch.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="LoE" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] issued his '''State of the Republic address''' before a special session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[State of the Republic address|address]] occurred in the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and thus focused heavily on the progress of the conflict and the Chancellor's vision for future warfare between the two belligerents. Palpatine outlined in his speech his reasons for continuing the war despite growing opposition from [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]], giving particular emphasis to the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] and the dangers posed by Confederate holdouts in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|targeted regions]]. Nevertheless, the Supreme Chancellor made an effort to reassure the people of the Republic that there was clear reason for optimism in the war, as the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] had been driven out of many Republic territories.

The Chancellor's State of the Republic address was met with great praise from many of his colleagues in the Senate, a majority of whom supported a continuation of the war. Among the minority opposed to Palpatine's policies stood the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and members of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa's]] anti-war coalition. In the aftermath of the address, the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] came [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|under attack]] by the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who attempted to capitalize on the timing of the speech in order to strike at the planet when a large number of Republic dignitaries would be present. The address was the final of its kind, as it was given only days prior to the demise of the Republic and the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Historical context==
{{Quote|Unfortunately, the fact of the matter is that the war is far from won, and I, for one, am not entirely satisfied that traitors and terrorists are not a continued threat to public safety. Oh, I realized that our victories give all appearances of a quick resolution to the war, but as of this morning I was informed that the Separatists still hold many key worlds in the Outer Rim, and that our sieges there could go on indefinitely.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, in a private meeting with the Loyalist Committee|<ref name="LoE" />}}
[[File:Sithdelscener1pic2.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Members of the Loyalist Committee discuss their grievances with Palpatine's policies.]]
Following the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] of [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] became engulfed in the brutal and far-reaching [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The struggle between the dominant [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] carried on for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and witnessed a number of shifts in the balance of power throughout countless battles across thousands of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="LoE" /> By around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Republic enjoyed relative security, particularly in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Confederacy had largely been driven from the Core and the surrounding [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions, which allowed the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to initiate the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] at the behest of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the leader of the democracy. Prior to that point, Palpatine had amassed increased [[Politics/Legends|political]] power within the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellery]] at an unprecedented rate via [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|constitutional]] amendments and security enhancements, all of which were approved by his vast support bloc in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="LoE" />

Because the war appeared to be nearing an end, a number of Palpatine's opponents on the Senate's [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] proposed a cessation of hostilities between the Republic and Confederacy and an exhalation of power from the Chancellor's office.<ref name="LoE" /> Palpatine, who was in fact a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, had been secretly manipulating both sides of the war since the conflict's beginning in a grand scheme to seize control of the galaxy.<ref name="RotSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> As his plans were not yet ready to come to fruition, he insisted to his opponents that the war was far from won and that the Confederacy still represented a very real threat to the Republic's democracy. Days later, the [[Time/Legends|time]] came for the Chancellor to make his [[State of the Republic address]], wherein he would enunciate his opinion on the Republic's condition and outline his administration's plans for the future. In anticipation of the event, numerous Republic delegates traveled to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to witness the speech firsthand and partake in the festivities that traditionally followed a State of the Republic address.<ref name="LoE" />

==Summary==
{{Quote|And so it is with a heavy heart that I commit two hundred thousand additional troopers to the Outer Rim sieges, though in full confidence that the end of this brutal conflict is now in sight. Cast from the Core, expelled from the Inner Rim and Colonies, driven from the Mid Rim, and soon to be exiled in the spiral arms, the Confederacy will pay a dear price for what they have brought down upon our fair house.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, in his address to the Republic populace|<ref name="LoE" />}}
Palpatine's 19 BBY State of the Republic address was made before a special session of the Senate, and was largely typical of the façade that the Chancellor had presented to the public during the war years&mdash;he appeared as a kindly and unassuming elected official, while he simultaneously acted as a great champion of democracy.<ref name="LoE" /><ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> His speech focused on a number of factors; first, the Chancellor announced that he would be committing two hundred thousand additional [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the Republic's sieges of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The number represented a full fifty percent of Coruscant's [[Coruscant Defense Fleet/Legends|home defense fleet]]. The Chancellor asserted that the onus was on the Republic to press the attack against the Confederacy, particularly on the worlds he targeted as a "[[Triad of Evil/Legends|Triad of Evil]]." Palpatine's Triad consisted of three planets: [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. All three worlds were bastions of the Confederacy, heavily defended by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], and thus branded as threats to the body of the Republic by the Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Felucia_SWCT.png|thumb|200px|Felucia, one of the three worlds in Palpatine's "Triad of Evil"]]
Secondly&mdash;in stark contrast to what he had told the Loyalist Committee in their private meeting days prior&mdash;Palpatine attempted to reassure the populace that the war was close to an end, despite the continued fighting in the Outer Rim. He lauded the Republic's expulsion of Confederate forces from the Core Worlds, [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and asserted that the Separatists would pay dearly for the harm they had inflicted on the Republic over the course of the war. He tempered his statements with claims of his preference not to continue the war and that he would rather simply allow the Confederacy to suffer its own [[Death/Legends|death]] alone in the Outer Rim, while Republic forces and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders returned to safety. However, Palpatine continued on, proclaiming that the choice did not rest solely with his wishes, and so he was required to continue the fighting so that the "enemies of democracy" would have no opportunity to rest and regroup for another strike at the Republic. In his statements, the Chancellor likened the Confederacy to a contagious disease that, if left untreated, would return to threaten future generations of the Republic.<ref name="LoE" />

Finally, the Supreme Chancellor spoke of the post-war galaxy and the work that would be required from himself and the Senate in the new political climate. Palpatine alluded to the rebuilding and reordering of the Republic and made specific mention of a restructuring of the Galactic Constitution. Furthermore, he stated that it would be the responsibility of the Senate to offer advice on which Confederate worlds the Chancellor should welcome back into the government and which he should exile from the democracy altogether. Palpatine concluded his speech with a request that the Senate work to establish a new spirit throughout the Republic that might foster thousands of years of peace, similar to the [[Republic Classic era|Great Peace]] that the democracy enjoyed up until the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the Clone Wars. Throughout the duration of the address, Palpatine was accompanied by twenty-four [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], who stood at the first level below the summit of the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]].<ref name="LoE" />

==Reception and results==
===Aftermath of the speech===
{{Quote|I just wanted all of you to know that, despite what the HoloNet news might lead you to believe, not all of us were on our feet.|Senator Bail Organa, to the Jedi High Council|<ref name="LoE" />}}
[[File:BailOrganaOfficialPix.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Bail Organa (pictured) made his way to the Jedi Temple to discuss Palpatine's address, assuring the Jedi that not everyone agreed with the Chancellor.]]
Palpatine's speech was extremely well-received by most of the Senate, who interrupted the Chancellor's address numerous times to applaud his propositions and policies. The phenomena&mdash;which had not been witnessed since the reign of Chancellor [[Eixes Valorum]]&mdash;caused the speech to last for a full four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], as Palpatine had to repeatedly pause to allow the applause and cheers to die down. The State of the Republic was publicly broadcast by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], whose [[Cam droid/Legends|cam droids]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Dome]] focused primarily on the Palpatine-loyal factions and widely ignored those senators who chose not to rejoice at the Chancellor's declarations. Following the event, opposition leader and [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to meet with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and discuss Palpatine's statements.<ref name="LoE" />

While the Council watched the broadcast, Organa assured them that not every member of the Senate had been as enthusiastic as those shown. The Jedi expressed particular disapproval of Palpatine and the legislation that had granted him unprecedented power over the course of the war, and so were highly skeptical of his dedication to end the conflict and his devotion to democracy. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] specifically took issue with the presence of the [[Navy/Legends|Naval]] officers and interpreted the move as a show of force. [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], who served the Republic as a [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]], was taken aback by the Chancellor's mention of a Constitutional restructuring and did not agree with the decision to deploy half of Coruscant's home forces to the Outer Rim. Both [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] ridiculed the "Triad of Evil" proposed in the address and insinuated that the targeted worlds were too insignificant to represent any real threat to the Republic. Organa and his anti-war Senate colleagues held the same views, believing that the push against the worlds in question was part of a concerted effort to acquire worlds by force and achieve direct control over [[Star system/Legends|system]] governments for the Chancellor's office.<ref name="LoE" />

===Military response and celebration===
The Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] of the Republic complied with Palpatine's decrees and dispersed from Coruscant to the targeted worlds of the "Triad of Evil." As the violence escalated on Mygeeto, Saleucami, Felucia, and across the entirety of the Outer Rim, senators and Republic dignitaries reveled on the capital, enjoying numerous parties and celebratory balls held in honor of the Supreme Chancellor's address. Although outward appearances suggested that the populace had bought into Palpatine's claims that the war was nearly won, it was noted by Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that many of the visiting nobles arranged personal protection, wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]], or arranged various modes of emergency escape from the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] for the duration of their stay on Coruscant. Indeed, while Palpatine's platitudes had convinced many that they were safe, the nature of security enforcement on the capital caused a concurrent sensation of underlying fear.<ref name="LoE" />

[[File:Spacebattle.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Battle of Coruscant saw heavy Republic losses early on due to Palpatine's dispersal of the Coruscant Home Fleet.]]
It was during the days of celebration that Palpatine, in his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alter ego of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, arranged for an [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attack]] on Coruscant. The Chancellor was content with the thin spread of Jedi and Republic forces across the galaxy, and so ordered that the Confederacy of Independent Systems' [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], invade the capital world and take Palpatine hostage. Grievous eagerly complied and invaded Coruscant while the world still entertained dignitaries who had not yet returned to their constituents.<ref name="LoE" /> The General had just enough time to complete his mission before the dispersed Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] returned to the capital to engage the Confederacy. Palpatine was rescued by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Grievous was forced to retreat. The Republic victory on Coruscant served to earn the Chancellor even more political capital, which he used to institute the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] and further enhance security measures in the Republic's core. Ultimately, just days after his State of the Republic address, Palpatine called an [[Special session of Congress/Legends|Extraordinary Session]] of Congress, wherein he issued the [[Declaration of a New Order]], which allowed him to seize total control over the government and transform it into the authoritarian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RotSn" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Some readers have accused me of including President Bush in the mix, but this is not the case. I borrowed the term "Homeworld Security" from one of the Dark Horse ''Republic'' comics, and my play on "Axis of Evil" was not an attempt to draw parallels between Bush and Palpatine, but to pay light-hearted homage to what I consider a very interesting phrase.|James Luceno|<ref name="Clone Warz">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarz.com/features/interviews/luceno.htm|text=JAMES LUCENO INTERVIEW|author=[[Nathan O'Keefe]]|date=2005-04|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20061129083714/http://www.clonewarz.com The Unofficial Clone Wars Site]|archivedate=20061115060448|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
The State of the Republic address of 19 BBY was portrayed in ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', a [[2005]] novel by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="LoE" /> The institution of the State of the Republic address has been likened to the [[Wikipedia:State of the Union address|State of the Union address]] issued annually by the [[Wikipedia:President of the United States|President]] of the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States of America]] to the [[Wikipedia:United States Congress|United States Congress]] by several readers of ''Labyrinth of Evil''. These readers have also drawn comparisons between Palpatine's mentions of the "Triad of Evil" and President [[Wikipedia:George W. Bush|George W. Bush's]] mentions of an "[[Wikipedia:Axis of Evil|Axis of Evil]]" in his [[Wikipedia:2002 State of the Union Address|2002 State of the Union address]].<ref name="tfn">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/books/reviews/r_labyrinthofevil.asp|text=TheForce.Net&ndash;Books&ndash;Reviews&ndash;Labyrinth of Evil by James Luceno|archivedate=20050214010234}}</ref><ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=review/R1YPDZ6QB43Q9I|text=Labyrinth of Evil Customer Review}}</ref> Luceno himself claimed that was not his intention, stating he was just interested in drawing on what he considered "a very interesting phrase." He claimed, further, that his usage in the book was just a "light-hearted homage."<ref name="Clone Warz" />
